user.title: CFA Pager
user.description:
Watch a POCSAG pager feed and raise Home Assistant events when your brigades are paged.

Enter brigades as station names (LAHARUM), alphacodes (LAHA) or raw capcodes (575488). The client ID must differ from any other client on the same broker.

data_description.topics: agency/# gives each page once. A bare # delivers every page three times, because the feed republishes under message_type and incident_type as well.
data_description.brigades: Station names, alphacodes or capcodes. Anything that cannot be resolved is reported rather than ignored.
data_description.username: Leave blank for an anonymous broker. pocsag.info accepts anonymous connections.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage, in plain text, like every other integration credential.
data_description.tls: Turn on for a broker on 8883. pocsag.info does not offer TLS.
data_description.tls_insecure: Only for a broker with a self-signed certificate. Leave off otherwise.

error.unresolved: Could not resolve: {unresolved}. Use a station name, an alphacode, or a numeric capcode.
error.no_brigades: Add at least one brigade, or nothing will ever alert.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the broker. Check the host, the port, and whether TLS is required.

init.title: CFA Pager options
init.description:
Currently watching: {resolved}

Saving tests the connection, then reloads the integration, so changes apply immediately without restarting Home Assistant.

data.page_history: Recent pages to keep for display

data_description.dedupe_seconds: The same brigade and message text arriving twice inside this window counts once. 0 disables it.
data_description.history: Kept in an attribute and restored across restarts, so no database is needed.
data_description.username: Leave blank for an anonymous broker. pocsag.info accepts anonymous connections.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage, in plain text, like every other integration credential.
data_description.tls: Turn on for a broker on 8883. pocsag.info does not offer TLS.
data_description.tls_insecure: Only for a broker with a self-signed certificate. Leave off otherwise.
data_description.client_id: Must differ from any other client on the same broker, or the two connections will keep kicking each other off.
data_description.page_history: Shown by sensor.cfa_recent_pages, all traffic and not just your brigades. Set to 0 to turn the entity off. Exclude it from the recorder: it changes on every page, roughly 670 times a day.
data_description.radar_product: Bureau of Meteorology radar id, written as IDR then the station number then the range digit. Range 1 is 512 km, 2 is 256 km, 3 is 128 km, 4 is 64 km. IDR952 is Rainbow at 256 km. Leave blank to turn the radar off.
data_description.radar_frames: How many recent scans to animate. Six covers about half an hour.
data_description.radar_interval: The Bureau publishes a scan every few minutes, so rebuilding faster than 300 seconds gains nothing.
data_description.incident_url: A GeoJSON feed of incidents. Defaults to VicEmergency. Leave blank to turn the incidents sensor off.
data_description.incident_radius: Straight-line distance from Home Assistant's own home coordinates, so nothing else needs configuring.
data_description.incident_interval: How often to poll the feed.
data_description.incident_max: Nearest first, so a low number keeps the closest ones.
data_description.media_player: Any media player. A player that supports announcements will duck the stream for the alert tone instead of stopping it.
data_description.streams: One per line, as the name you want on the key, an equals sign, then the stream address. The select entity switches between them.
data_description.stream_username: For a stream behind HTTP Basic auth. Left blank, none is sent.
data_description.stream_password: Injected into the stream URL when playing, not stored in the URL.
data_description.play_seconds: How long the stream stays open after a callout. Each further callout extends it. A listen started by hand ignores this and plays until switched off.
data_description.audio_enabled: Turn off to keep the entities but stay silent.
data_description.alert_enabled: Turn off to open the stream with no tone.

clear_history.description: Forget stored callouts and recent pages.

callouts.description: Forget the callout history and the last callout.
